title: Ubwami aho iherezo ry’Umugaba ryagiye ritaboneka
intro: Amateka yaramenye abategetsi b’ubwoko bwose, mugabo bake ni bo bategetse ubutegetsi bumeze nk’ubu. Aho umuyaga ubwawo wishura itegeko ryabo kandi abakozi ata jisho ry’umuntu rishobora kubona bakora cane mu gacerere, iyo ngoma ntiyari imeze nk’iyindi yariho imbere canke inyuma. Yamara rero, mbere n’ubwami buhambaye kuruta ubundi bwose butegerezwa guhera—kandi igihe ubu bwahera, ukuri kwavuye mw’isoko yicishije bugufi cane ku buryo ata n’umwe yari yiyumviriye kubukeka.
clues: Nahawe ubwami buhambaye cane n’Umukama wanje, buvugwa hirya no hino ku mapaji meranda.
Narazwe ubwenge n’ubukuru bikomeye biva ku muvyeyi yagenda imbere yanje mu kwihebera Imana.
Nategetse umuyaga nyene, uragenda kure kubera imigambi yanje.
Ibiremwa bitaboneka n’amaso asanzwe vyakora cane munsi y’ububasha bwanje, vyubaka ibitangaza bitagira uko bingana.
Amasôko y’umuringa ushonze yaratemba kuri jewe, umuhezagiro udasanzwe mu yatoranijwe na Allah.
Igihe nava muri iyi si, umubiri wanje wagumye uhagaze ku nkoni. Igihe ikiremwa gitoyi co kw’isi cariye muri iyo nkoni, ni ho gusa abo bari bakikuje bamenya ko naciye.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
